dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Okay, so we have an interaction today, an appointment. Let me first wake up the Seremate.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Hi, good morning. I am SereMate. How can I help you today?

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Good morning, SereMate. We have an appointment with Mr. Schmidt today and you should go see him in his room.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Okay, please provide the full name of the patient.

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: So the full name of the emm patient is James Schmidt.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Okay, please provide me with his room number.

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: The room number is 2001.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Okay, I will go wake up Mr. Schmidt now.

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Okay.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Hello. Good morning, Mr. Schmidt.

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Oh, good morning. Who are you?

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: I am SereMate, the new robot in the Serenity Springs Care Facility. I am here to remind you that you have a doctor's appointment now.

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Oh, thank you very much.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: The doctor's appointment is in another building.

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Oh em, can you please bring me my shoes?

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Of course. Which shoes do you want?

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: So my shoes are the very big one and they have the color gray.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Okay. Are these the correct shoes?

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Oh, yes, they are the correct shoes. Thank you very much. Let me put them on.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Excellent. Let's head to the appointment room right now.

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Okay. Oh, I don't know. Something is…

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Do you need assistance in walking?

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Oh, I think that would be helpful. Yes.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Okay. Locating stick. Here. I hope that helps.
dialogue.annotation: Grounding Acceptance, Narration of action, Offer, Inform

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: This looks perfectly fine. Yes. That's very good.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Great. Let's head to the appointment room.

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Let's go.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Hello, Mr. Schmidt. How did the doctor's appointment go?

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Oh, it was quite well.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Okay. Now I am here to remind you about your daily arm recovery exercises.

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Oh, thank you very much.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Let's start. Here is the dumbbell. You are required to do the elbow flexion exercise.

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Okay.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: It works like this.

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Oh, thank you very much. I didn't know what it was until you showed me. Oh, it's very, very heavy. (struggling)

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Okay. I will bring you another weight.

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Oh, that would be very helpful. I think my arm isn't quite ready yet for such heavy weight.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Try this one. It's lighter.

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Oh, yeah. That's very good.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Perfect.
